name: Biomedical Science PhD

english.toefl: 81 for tests beforeJanuary2026;4.5 for tests afterJanuary2026
english.note: University IELTS minimum7 overall with no subscore below6; PTE68 overall with no subscore below58. Program requirements may be higher. Country/qualifying-degree exemptions apply; see the central policy.

applicationFee.note: International fee 100 USD; domestic fee 60 USD. Central policy expressly excludes international fee waivers. BSP separately reimburses the application fee after an invited applicant completes the interview; confirm international reimbursement eligibility before relying on it.

requirements.note: Minimum GPA3.00/4 or evaluated foreign equivalent. The two-part application requires payment/submission first, then all supporting materials in MyUI.

detailsNote: The official December1 application deadline is recurring and not explicitly labeled for Fall2027. This is one first-year umbrella, not separate applications to each listed subprogram.

publishedDeadlines.label: Fall application deadline
publishedDeadlines.note: Official central program and current checklist agree on December1; year not stated. Older Molecular Medicine pages discuss a January1 final date, but the current BSP checklist requires all materials byDecember1.

funding.note: Stipend36350 for July1,2026–June30,2027, tuition/mandatory fees and health/dental benefits. Continued support after the first year depends on satisfactory progress. Not a confirmed2027–28 stipend.
